definition: the amount of space an object fills
description: A tiny attic bedroom with a round skylight, white beams and wooden floorboards, seen through the doorway. A giant inflatable pink flamingo fills almost the whole room from the bed up to the ceiling, its long neck bent under the roof beside a wicker lampshade. A laughing young woman in a mint top and white shorts is squashed against the wall beside it, one foot on the bed, pushing against the flamingo. An electric pump stands on the floor, and stacks of books and shelves are pushed to the edges.

de.answer: Er füllt das gesamte Volumen des Zimmers aus.
de.question: Was macht der Flamingo?

es.answer: Está llenando todo el volumen de la habitación.
